name: hardware-v2
note: Release architecture/timing matrix (U17, guide §10.1): six exact configurations X0-X5 at four clock targets and three route seeds (72 jobs) plus the precision study P1/P5/P6/P7 at 50 MHz on the same seeds (12 jobs; P0 overlaps X2) = 84 unique route jobs. One synthesis per configuration (-nodsp), reused across targets and seeds. Timeouts are observed resource limits under the declared budget, never proof that a design cannot route; four lanes get a larger budget after the U13 pilots (seed 1 timed out at 1,200 s and 3,600 s, seed 2 routed in 214 s).
resource_policy: sequential runner (one nextpnr process), heartbeat <= 60 s, resume by full route identity, failures and timeouts retained as outcomes, retries only as declared attempts with a reason
